notes.title: Updates and new game!
notes.content: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p]A new update is coming for the game with [b]improved graphics and Bug fixes[/b] soon next month and also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in an enhanced edition![/p][p] [/p][p]Meanwhile if you want to check out our [b]new upcoming adventure game[/b][/p][p]check it out: Follow and add to your wishlist here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/?curator_clanid=10153659"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]In this game you'll follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set sail with Mai and travel through time, journeying across both past and future, thanks to a Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Observe how the world transforms before your eyes and adapt your actions accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3499550/extras/Gif4.4_2.gif?t=1752767160"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay & A Deep Storyline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as Mai in the different stages of her life, harnessing the unique abilities in childhood and adolescence to face the challenges ahead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience a natural progression of gameplay mechanics, from precision platforming to hack and slash combat, while unlocking new abilities for Mai through Metroidvania-style progression, expanding her exploration and combat possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate, abandoned factories to discover and submerged worlds to explore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gather hidden clues with Mai to unravel the past, uncovering the events that led to humanity’s extinction, and discover what fate awaits the world after their disappearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The game is coming in September, stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]For more info, join our Discord Server![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel"]https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Challenge Action - Make our servers crash!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
[b]We would like to start a new funny contest, you'll have to make our servers CRASH![/b]

In order to do that there will have to be A LOT of gamers playing [b]"Heaven Island VR MMO"[/b] ːbuddhaː and interacting with the environment. 

Invite your friends to play the game with you if you want to win!

Right now there are 200+ players connected to the game, if we reach 1000 gamers the server will probably crash and all of you connected to the game will win the prize!

The prize is a new key for our next game in development "The Rex" :)
[b]Contest ends the 7th of March.[/b]

let the challenge begin! ːespritː

	[/h1]

notes.title: New Name change! - Heaven Island VR MMO!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends!
I would like to inform you that we had to change the name of the game due to some legal problems with a company with the same registered name.

We hope you'll like the new name we chose "Heaven Island - VR MMO"

we're still taking in consideration other names, let us know if you have any suggestions!

New updates will come in the next week.

with love, ːespritː
Chubby Pixel
[/h1]
